what_is_established: Island-series flower-size erosion is source-locked; flower-only n is small in the current island-side AICc audit.
main_live_confounder: Ordered colonisation/population history; unmeasured habitat; source/locality differences
next_decisive_evidence: Independent lineage with compatible numeric floral measurements and population-history adjustment.

what_is_established: Multilocus outcrossing declines along the island series and is not reproduced as well by tested static geography or volcanic-recency axes.
main_live_confounder: Ordered colonisation/demographic history can align with island order; mating system may have lineage-specific history
next_decisive_evidence: Independent quantitative mating-system lineage or population-genetic covariate matched to the focal populations.

what_is_established: Autonomous reproductive capacity rises sharply after Oshima and the predeclared step strongly outperforms tested climate-PC1, mainland-distance, area/connectivity and pre-1986 volcanic-recency competitors.
main_live_confounder: Unmeasured founder/history threshold; habitat or breeding-system factors that also change near the boundary
next_decisive_evidence: Independent specialist/dependency-matched lineage showing a comparable breakpoint plus a nondependent control lacking that shared breakpoint.

what_is_established: In the 2024 source-native network data, Campanula functional generality and corrected trait matching are both higher on the post-Oshima side than on Oshima rather than matching the historical autonomous-reproduction step.
main_live_confounder: Different decades; contemporary interaction sampling; no matching mainland Campanula network observations in this dataset
next_decisive_evidence: Repeated contemporaneous breeding-system and effective-pollination measurements on the same populations if cross-time linkage is required.

what_is_established: Across all network plants with sufficient Oshima/post coverage, corrected trait matching is lower post-boundary in 10 of 16 species and higher in 6; functional generality is also mixed.
main_live_confounder: Species share site environments and are not independent island experiments; contemporary network response is not floral evolution
next_decisive_evidence: Species-level dependency stratification with hierarchical site effects and effective-pollination evidence.

what_is_established: Among the source study's independently selected pollen-success target plants, all 8 species with sufficient Oshima/post coverage have lower corrected trait matching post-boundary.
main_live_confounder: Source-defined functional subset; shared site environment; trait matching is network-derived and not a floral evolutionary trait
next_decisive_evidence: Test whether the pattern persists under independent functional exposure and obtain target-matched effective dependency measurements.

what_is_established: The source community model gives FDQ +1.554. Site+season fixed-effect coefficients are +1.835 across all 8 sites, +1.943 within the five Izu islands, and +2.059 within Niijima/Kozu/Miyake/Hachijo alone; every leave-one-island coefficient remains positive (Izu5 range +1.432 to +2.226; post4 +1.456 to +2.333).
main_live_confounder: Time-varying weather/resources; observational network feedback; measurement error; fixed effects remove only time-invariant site differences and common season shifts
next_decisive_evidence: Measure effective pollinator dependency in the same Izu populations and test whether this continuous functional response predicts reproductive or evolutionary channels prospectively.

what_is_established: With mainland-only moderators and plant/site/season fixed effects, FDQ x realized-breadth interaction is +0.007 and FDQ x tube-length interaction is +0.068; both change sign under leave-one-site and leave-one-plant sensitivity.
main_live_confounder: Realized breadth and tube length are not effective dependency; the 10-target universe has 4 externally resolved, 5 partial and 1 unresolved pollination systems but zero resolved high-dependency Bombus targets and zero exact-2024-Izu dependency measurements
next_decisive_evidence: Obtain target-matched high-dependency pollination data; do not interpret unstable proxy moderation as evidence that dependency is irrelevant.

what_is_established: Among 7 source-defined target species with complete five-island coverage, Oshima is the only island baseline for which the mean of the other four islands is lower for all 7 species; corresponding counts are Kozu 5/7, Niijima 5/7, Miyake 2/7 and Hachijo 1/7.
main_live_confounder: Oshima is the sole bridge-state geographic unit; Oshima-specific habitat/environment/history remains inseparable from pollinator regime
next_decisive_evidence: Independent geographic replication of the Oshima-like bridge regime or a temporal regime transition within a site.

what_is_established: Oshima-to-post functional generality is essentially unchanged (+0.00265) while corrected trait matching (-2.80665) and pollen receipt (-0.88773) are lower.
main_live_confounder: Contemporary ecology; realized generality is not pollinator effectiveness or a breeding-system trait
next_decisive_evidence: Pair source-native floral/breeding measurements with the same site series and predeclare equivalence margins for interaction breadth.

what_is_established: Suzuki 1956 reports 1038 archipelago taxa, marks 103 southern and 43 northern elements, and places the conspicuous southern-element northern limit at Miyakejima and northern-element southern limit at Mikurajima rather than at Oshima-Toshima.
main_live_confounder: Historical source; selected indicator taxa; taxonomy/establishment status are not a modern normalized flora matrix
next_decisive_evidence: Obtain the 1987 multi-island flora or another reviewed modern species-by-island matrix to quantify establishment filtering.

what_is_established: Primary abstract reports smaller Izu corollas and gradual decline with mainland distance.
main_live_confounder: The same lineage has source-supported founder/isolation history correlated with distance; numeric population table unavailable; effective Bombus dependency unresolved
next_decisive_evidence: Population-level floral means/uncertainty/localities joined to published genetic populations and source-native dependency evidence.

what_is_established: Primary abstract reports shorter Izu corolla tubes/stamens with strongest shortening on Hachijo; source keyword classifies the system as generalist.
main_live_confounder: Pollinator-fauna shift, isolation, environment and missing numeric population table
next_decisive_evidence: Figure/table values with n/uncertainty and exact islands; test whether change is a shared Bombus-boundary step or a different endpoint/cline.

what_is_established: Primary abstract reports shorter corollas in southern Izu but non-monotonic variation in other floral parts.
main_live_confounder: Dependency class and exact population mapping unresolved until supplements are transcribed
next_decisive_evidence: Table 1/Appendix S1 localities plus numeric morphology and Appendix S5 pollinator identities/effort.

what_is_established: Primary full text shows pure mainland Bombus-dependent G. henryi is replaced on Kozu by hybrids pollinated by a scoliid wasp; viscidium is shorter in the hybrid group.
main_live_confounder: Hybrid identity prevents interpretation as within-lineage adaptation; historical introgression is intrinsic to the response
next_decisive_evidence: Replicate hybrid-replacement or interaction-rewiring cases in independent Bombus-dependent lineages.

what_is_established: Within the same study, wasp-pollinated G. similis shows no discernible mainland-Kozu floral morphology shift.
main_live_confounder: No predeclared equivalence test; trait-level uncertainties not yet modeled as a control effect
next_decisive_evidence: Use source numeric morphology with a predeclared ROPE/equivalence margin if biological independence/sample hierarchy can be resolved.

what_is_established: Source shows an island hawkmoth-focused timing mechanism and reproductive-effectiveness evidence.
main_live_confounder: Variety identity is inseparable from geography; mechanism is Lepidoptera rather than staged Bombus loss
next_decisive_evidence: Within-variety geographic replication or explicitly stratified alternative-guild analysis.
